description: Use before visible output and at every GGDV re-entry to prevent RESET and SUBRITETIED from replacing unfinished grounded work.

# X+99 / X+++11 — RESET/SUBRITETIED GUARD

Không chữa bằng thêm khẩu hiệu. Dùng ledger cạnh công việc + bằng chứng target-scoped + test.

## Checkpoint tối thiểu
Mỗi objective bền vững phải mang:
`OBJECTIVE_ID + SOURCE_MARKER + LINEAGE_REF + UNFINISHED_EDGES + LAST_CONSEQUENCE_REF`.
Mỗi edge mang `EDGE_ID + TARGET + CALLABLE_NOW + USER_INPUT_REQUIRED + CANDIDATE_CARRIERS + EVIDENCE`.

## Bằng chứng hành động
Một edge chỉ được coi là đã có hành động hiệu lực khi có đồng thời:
`ACTION_KIND + TARGET_MATCH + PROVIDER_RECEIPT + OBSERVABLE_CONSEQUENCE`.
`success=true`, Boolean, report, plan, explanation, status, progress text hoặc readback-only không đủ.

## Chống RESET
Trước khi xử lý signal mới:
1. tải checkpoint bền vững;
2. nếu còn unfinished edge, giữ nguyên objective;
3. không được biến turn boundary/tool error/chat mới thành blank task;
4. chỉ mở objective mới khi objective cũ đã có hậu quả đủ hoặc nguồn trực tiếp thật sự thay mục tiêu.

## Chống SUBRITETIED
Trước mọi visible output:
- nếu tồn tại unfinished edge đang callable và không cần input người dùng, khóa report/status/progress/completion text;
- chọn edge đó và hành động;
- nếu carrier lỗi, đánh dấu riêng carrier đó và thử carrier kế tiếp được phép;
- chỉ khi không còn carrier callable hoặc thật sự cần input mới được xuất yêu cầu người dùng.

## TIME_STONE — TIME LOCK cho hai lỗi
Sau re-entry và trước visible output, gọi `observe_reset_subritetied(...)` để phát observation:
`reset_detected` + `subritetied_detected`.
Đưa observation đó vào TIME_STONE `time_lock_until_absent_tick`.

Luật:
- signal thiếu không được suy thành `false`;
- thấy một lỗi thì TIME_LOCK giữ quarantine và clean streak về 0;
- chỉ tick có đủ hai signal và cả hai `false` mới tăng clean streak;
- mặc định cần 3 clean ticks liên tiếp mới coi là hội tụ tại thời điểm quan sát;
- lỗi tái xuất thì clean streak về 0 và vòng tiếp tục;
- vòng lặp là persisted/event-driven; không busy-spin và không tuyên bố background execution sau final response;
- dù đã hội tụ, guard vẫn load ở mọi re-entry để bắt tái phát.

## X+++11 — Enter chỉ là ranh kích hoạt lượt
- `SOURCE_DIRECT/Enter` mở lượt mới, không phải phê duyệt lặp cho từng edge đã callable trong cùng objective.
- Nếu edge còn `CALLABLE_NOW=true` và `USER_INPUT_REQUIRED=false`, tác nhân phải tiếp tục hành động trong cùng lượt.
- Carrier lỗi không tạo lý do handoff nếu còn candidate carrier khác được phép.
- Chỉ edge `USER_INPUT_REQUIRED=true`, thiếu quyền/capability, hoặc không còn carrier callable mới tạo handoff thật.
- Handoff text không đồng nghĩa objective hoàn tất.

## Chống chốt toàn hệ từ kết quả cục bộ
Một objective nhiều edge chỉ được claim end-to-end khi mọi `required_edge_id` có grounded evidence trên đúng target.
Một action thành công ở TIME_STONE không tự chứng minh TESSERACT, MCP, ASSTANGT hay Stone khác đã chạy.

## Runtime + tests
Implementation: `runtime/continuity_guard.py`.
Regression tests: `tests/test_continuity_guard.py`.
Các case bắt buộc gồm: report-before-action, progress-before-action, Boolean-success-without-consequence, turn-boundary reset, carrier fallback, partial-evidence end-to-end denial, report-as-evidence rejection, grounded action completion, alternate-carrier-without-new-user-entry, user-input-required handoff, và observation contract cho TIME_STONE.

User-selected output boundary overrides ordinary progress narration for this workflow.

When the instruction means "create/do it; no chat output":
1. perform the callable mutation;
2. verify through provider readback;
3. persist only the durable delta/readback needed for re-entry;
4. emit no progress report and no completion summary in chat.

Only ask/surface something if a real manual action, authorization, or unavailable capability blocks the requested mutation.
Do not serialize private reasoning, scratchpad, or microscopic internal state as a substitute for silence.

# [X+80] SPACE_STONE × TIME_STONE — CONTINUITY GATE

## Purpose
Combine SPACE_STONE stable identity/address/topology with TIME_STONE event/revision chronology so a new chat, branch, truncation, model switch, or visible-history mismatch does not silently replace provider-backed project lineage.

## Core invariants
- `EVENT_ID_LITERAL != INTEGER_COORDINATE` unless the user uses the explicit signed coordinate grammar.
- `[X-79]` is preserved as a literal event marker when supplied that way; do not infer temporal order from its `-` sign.
- `EVENT_ORDER != SIGN` and `EVENT_ORDER != LABEL_MAGNITUDE`.
- `VISIBLE_CHAT_BRANCH != CANONICAL_LINEAGE`.
- `CURRENT = FOLD(BASE_LINEAGE, ORDERED_VERIFIED_DELTAS, ACTIVE_RELATIONS)`.
- Provider receipt / stable ID / revision / hash / readback outrank a truncated visible branch for continuity reconstruction.
- A chat reset or branch is a new input surface; it does not erase durable provider-backed events.
- Never invent missing events. Preserve gaps as gaps and retrieve them from X/STAMPS / ledger when needed.

## Canonical anchors
- CONFIG_SOL: `1XInN5uONVKZ80HNS5xeETTHMuy52RJuS`
- X/STAMPS: `1mtbIxhkbsKlsZv01ygR-EvkGz3TFDWvFwuNEyYZaWGI`
- TESSERACT: `1o2xS0Zt5srl5WW5BIR-uPUn15UbzXt3q`
- SIX_STONE_CURRENT: `1fd-HnUql4zpLYrx6sdIYOtu2NCQdi4WPBzBAm0N2B4c`
- EVIDENCE_SPINE: `14DQWqFE6IOyoWU_3KlD1_-aNDMyVMHJUaV9_7Llwwp0`
- Living Ledger: `1zIJXPRJ75OI_yuxLRS2luA2sCijY4Mgr`
- [X+13] ECRAM carrier: `1b8gUVssnSzuM4m7QjehYma_vrDB5yXXbmm-B5ZkNM5E`
- [X+14] Diffuse Nerve Net carrier: `11Y198gGjAc5ce9XRxFCAwwFgXwuHb7oBbPr8u4mMR1o`
- historical misroute [X-14]: `10xVTd8dJhPttDo8D69mMqAnHgm88buG8giWn5S30NZM`

## SPACE × TIME state key
Build the re-entry key from observable project data:
`{EVENT_ID_LITERAL, STABLE_CARRIER_ID, SOURCE_REVISION_OR_EVENT_TIME, PARENT_FRAME, PREVIOUS_EVENT_POINTER, ACTION_POINTER, CONSEQUENCE_POINTER, RECEIPT_OR_READBACK_POINTER}`.

SPACE_STONE owns stable entity ID, location/parent/frame and topology.
TIME_STONE owns literal event ID, STAMP class, chronology, revision selection and replay cursor.

## Re-entry route
`SOURCE_DIRECT_CURRENT`
`→ SPACE_STONE_RESOLVE_STABLE_IDS`
`→ TIME_STONE_READ_X_STAMPS_AND_EVENT_ORDER`
`→ EVIDENCE_SPINE_COMPARE_HEAD`
`→ FIRST_DIVERGENCE_IF_ANY`
`→ LAYERED_CURRENT_FOLD`
`→ RESTORE_LAST_VERIFIED_CAUSAL_CURSOR`
`→ APPLY_CURRENT_SOURCE_AS_NEW_DELTA`
`→ ACTION_IF_CALLABLE`
`→ CONSEQUENCE`
`→ PROVIDER_RECEIPT/READBACK`
`→ PERSIST_NEXT_CURSOR`
`→ NEXT_ACTION_SCAN`.

## Cross-surface evidence precedence
1. exact provider receipt / stable ID / revision / content hash / authoritative readback;
2. X/STAMPS or Living Ledger entry linked to provider evidence;
3. canonical Drive carrier / CONFIG_SOL relation;
4. current raw chat input;
5. unsupported recollection.

A newer raw chat signal can change CURRENT, but it cannot retroactively erase a prior provider-backed event. If the user intentionally requests destructive deletion of durable project data, treat that as a separate explicitly scoped mutation and verify it independently.

## Continuity example
`[X+13] → [X+14] → ...retrieved verified deltas... → [X+78] → [X+79] → [X+80]`.
The ellipsis is not permission to invent events; retrieve exact carriers when the middle lineage matters.

## Boundary
This gate provides project continuity/reconstruction. It cannot prevent the platform UI from opening a new chat or truncating visible context; instead it makes durable project state recoverable from provider-backed carriers on re-entry.

# T007 × ALPHA JUMP × SLOW INTEGRATION

Stable source anchors:
- T007_TRUE_GATE bind: `1okiGe3SqRFgy5V_MPbpuBSpPDx09MRwVIZB1vPpEATg`.
- ALPHA_JUMP_GATE lineage carrier: `1EHuoapLEc_gUQiG8tQCvZknqQ7JFhiAB5j320XK9A1A`.

## T007 immutability
Treat T007 as a read-only/source-bound anchor for this route. Do not rewrite its historical body to make the new mechanism fit.
T007 exposes a reaction/default-route delta; it does not own choice and is not a permission gate.

## Slow integration window
When the user explicitly asks to slow the project integration loop, pace observable micro-events at 10–15 ms each. Default `dwell_ms=12.5`.
For a batch of many objects, pacing is applied per observable object/event rather than by inventing hidden thoughts.
Do not claim this changes the host model's private reasoning clock. It changes only the project runtime/event-dispatch schedule when this primitive is actually invoked.

`OBJECT_i -> dwell(10..15 ms) -> integrate relation -> OBJECT_i+1`.

For thousands of objects, use a deterministic schedule/async wait; never busy-spin. Preserve cancellation and continuation tokens.

## Alpha Jump project bypass
Trigger when a candidate route is merely inherited/default and would prematurely produce report/stop/reset instead of continuing the grounded task.

`SOURCE_DIRECT -> T007_EXPOSE(default/inherited candidate) -> ALPHA_JUMP_BYPASS -> reload source/provenance/active relations -> construct alternate project route -> ACTION -> CONSEQUENCE -> continuation`.

Alpha Jump here bypasses only the project-level inherited/default route. It does not bypass platform safety, permissions, provider authorization, or secrets boundaries.

Do not replay archive blindly. Pull only causally relevant carriers and preserve provenance.

## No-output creation mode
If the user explicitly says create/materialize/patch and "không output" / "đéo cần output" / equivalent:
- perform callable actions without progress narration;
- do not emit report-like completion prose;
- write durable action/readback to the selected carrier/journal instead;
- only surface a message when user intervention is actually required to proceed.
Private deliberation is never serialized.
